name: Korihisa Kent
source:
A genius hacker who suddenly disappeared in 2012.

After he hacked into the Vatican’s computer network in 2010, his abilities were recognized by the institution, and he was subsequently hired as their Head Computer Technician.

[From [url=https://www.kirikiribasara.com/2022/06/08/anonymouscode-character-profile-translations/]Kiri Kiri Basara[/url]]
